raw_segments.text: He took the hilt of his ash-plint, lunging with it softly, dallying still.
Yes, evening will find itself in me without me.
By the way, next one is it Tuesday will be the longest day.
Of all the glad new year, mother, the rum-tum-tiddledy-tum.
Lawn Tennyson, gentleman poet, Gia, for the old hag with the yellow teeth.
And Monsieur Droumont, gentleman journalist, Gia, my teeth are very bad.
Why I wonder, feel, that one is going too, shells.
Ought I go to a dentist, I wonder, with that money.
Why is that, I wonder, or does it mean something perhaps?
